insight: Austria's performance in the 2026 FIFA World Cup shows that hydration breaks have a significant impact on their momentum. When they take a break, they tend to lose momentum, with an average decline of 0.062 minutes per break, indicating that their opponents often gain an advantage during this time. However, the numbers also suggest that Austria's strategy before the break plays a crucial role, as they tend to lose more momentum when they are pressing before the break, with a significant average decline of 0.160 minutes per minute, and only managing to maintain momentum once in five attempts. In contrast, when they are not pressing before the break, they actually tend to gain momentum, with an average increase of 0.100 minutes per minute, suggesting that a more defensive approach before the break may be a more effective strategy for Austria.
